response.overview: To get Xfinity to send a technician, call 866.465.1426 for live dispatch, or book an arrival slot via get help. Sharing your modem light status and signal drops helps skip repeat remote reboots.  What to prepare before you reach out  Having these details ready speeds up verification and cuts repeat transfers:  * Your Xfinity account number and service address  * Current modem light color and behavior (solid or blinking)  * Times when internet or TV drops most often  * Mobile number for two-hour arrival text alerts  Four steps to get an Xfinity technician sent out  1. Start by phone: Call 866.465.1426 and share your account number and describe the exact color of your modem status light.  2.
